- Federal passport/document regime: universal-ish exposure for trans travelers whose documents mismatch or who seek X markers. This is a tier-1-ish universal exposure? It's an entry-level exposure affecting visitors. Foreign governments issued travel advisories. - Federal custody: immigration detention abuse documented (forced labour, beatings, sexual abuse of trans men). Detention placement — the Jan 2025 EO rescinded prison LGBTQ protections; corrections bureau conversion therapy from 2026.
